pending.value: Government Code and Cypher School / Bletchley Park (1939–1945)
On Computable Numbers… (1936, PLMS) — universal Turing machine
Computing Machinery and Intelligence (Mind, October 1950) — Turing test / imitation game
Designed Bombe specification; first installation Bletchley Park March 1940
Convicted of gross indecency 1952; royal pardon 2013-12-24
The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis (Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B, 1952)
Bank of England £50 note portrait, issued 2021-06-23
ACM A. M. Turing Award named after him; 2018 recipients Hinton/Bengio/LeCun (two-hop into deep_learning specimen)

value.chain: 1950 imitation-game paper -> AI benchmark tradition -> LLM evaluation

disputed.value: cyanide poisoning; officially ruled suicide by inquest
disputed_alternatives: accidental cyanide inhalation from electroplating experiment (alternative theory; nephew Dermot Turing and some historians dispute the suicide interpretation, noting chemical experiments in the home and that the hormone treatment had ended in 1953)
possible deliberate re-enactment of the Snow White poisoned-apple scene (popular claim; not forensically established)
disputed._note: Placed in disputed section at sweep-1 because the manner_of_death is contested despite the official verdict. Wikidata marks manner as 'probably suicide'. The certainty 0.7 reflects the coroner's ruling against two named alternative accounts. This is a FRONTIER fact — the membrane is under conceptual attack even without a formal verification record yet.
